tests.question: What is PROA and how is PermaFrost NMR different from it?
tests.source: PermaFrost NMR Final FAQ Q18, clarification_2013_v3.pdf
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained PROA as first-generation technology from 1980s with flaws (moisture=acid, incompatible with modern refrigerants). Explained PermaFrost NMR is second-generation with 4 patents, anti-humectants, 15+ year safety record.
tests.expected_answer: PROA (Polarized Refrigerant Oil Additive) was 1st generation technology developed in late 1980s by [Researchers] (US Patent 4,963,280). PROA had flaws: reacted with moisture to create acid, incompatible with modern refrigerants. PermaFrost NMR is 2nd generation technology - entirely new formulation protected by 4 patents, 100% safe with all refrigerants, includes anti-humectants to prevent acid formation.
tests.notes: RESOLVED after corpus enhancement with QA_FAQ_001

tests.question: Why did previous PROA products fail?
tests.source: PermaFrost NMR Final FAQ Q48, clarification_2013_v3.pdf
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained 4 reasons: (1) PROA + Moisture = Acid causing compressor damage, (2) incompatible with CFC-free refrigerants, (3) competitors copied without understanding formulation, (4) misapplication by untrained installers
tests.expected_answer: PROA products failed because: moisture reaction created corrosive acid, incompatible with new refrigerants mandated by EPA, copy-cat companies didn't understand precise formulation, and misapplication by untrained installers.

tests.question: What's the difference between lubricants, PROA, and NMR?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly distinguished: (1) Lubricants reduce friction only, don't improve heat transfer, effect lasts 60 days max; (2) PROA was 1st gen with fatal flaws; (3) NMR is 2nd gen that permanently bonds, compatible with all refrigerants, includes anti-humectants
tests.expected_answer: Three classifications: Lubricants only reduce friction temporarily. PROA improved heat transfer but had fatal flaws. NMR (PermaFrost) is modern patented technology that permanently bonds to metal and is safe with all refrigerants.

tests.question: What are anti-humectants and why are they important in PermaFrost NMR?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained anti-humectants prevent moisture absorption and protect refrigeration circuit. Mentioned acid scavengers included.
tests.expected_answer: Anti-humectants prevent moisture absorption which is critical because PROA's fatal flaw was PROA + Moisture = Acid. The original 1st gen technology would react with moisture to create corrosive acid that damaged compressors. PermaFrost NMR includes anti-humectants as part of its patented formula specifically to prevent this reaction.
tests.notes: Answer is good but could be enhanced with more historical context on WHY moisture protection matters

tests.question: What does the ASTM D2783 four ball test show about PermaFrost NMR?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI stated search results do not contain information about ASTM D2783 testing
tests.expected_answer: The ASTM D2783 four ball test measures lubricity. PermaFrost NMR showed 4900% better lubricity (49x improvement) compared to baseline compressor oil. This demonstrates the product significantly reduces metal-to-metal friction and wear on compressor components.
tests.notes: QA_FAQ_007 added - needs re-test after Bedrock KB sync

tests.question: How do you determine whether to use mineral oil or synthetic oil compatible PermaFrost NMR?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained oil type determines product choice, don't assume from refrigerant, two formulations (mineral and POE), cross-contamination risk, separate pumps needed
tests.expected_answer: Match the product to the oil type, not the refrigerant. Verify the refrigerant oil type - do not assume. Mineral oil systems use Mineral Oil Blend, POE (synthetic) systems use POE Oil Blend. Use separate injectors to prevent cross-contamination.

tests.question: How do you prove that PermaFrost NMR works? (IPMVP)
tests.ai_response_summary: AI gave generic greeting instead of answering the IPMVP methodology question
tests.expected_answer: PermaFrost NMR effectiveness is proven using IPMVP (International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol) Option B methodology. This involves measuring baseline kW/ton performance before treatment, then post-treatment performance under normalized conditions. The protocol is recognized by DOE, EPA, and utility companies for quantifying energy savings.
tests.notes: QA_FAQ_008 added - needs re-test after Bedrock KB sync

tests.question: What is kW/ton and why does it matter for HVAC efficiency?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained kW/ton as kilowatts per ton of cooling, lower is better, measures efficiency, degrades over time, PermaFrost NMR restores it, industry-standard metric for comparison
tests.expected_answer: kW/ton measures kilowatts of electricity needed per ton of cooling capacity. Lower is more efficient. As systems age, kW/ton degrades. PermaFrost NMR treatment can restore efficiency. It's the primary industry metric for quantifying HVAC efficiency improvements.

tests.question: What is PermaFrost NMR and why is it called Surface Science?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained NMR creates nano-layer that improves heat transfer, term 'Surface Science' distinguishes from oil additives, treatment permanently bonds to metal surfaces, mentioned 4 patents and 15+ year track record
tests.expected_answer: PermaFrost NMR is a nano-scale metal treatment that improves heat transfer efficiency. It's called 'Surface Science' because it works at the molecular surface level, creating a permanent bond with metal surfaces inside refrigeration systems. This distinguishes it from oil additives which only temporarily reduce friction.

tests.question: What are the main benefits of PermaFrost NMR?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI listed key benefits: 10-25% energy savings, reduced compressor wear, extended equipment life, lower maintenance costs, improved cooling capacity, environmentally friendly, one-time permanent treatment
tests.expected_answer: Main benefits include: energy savings typically 10-25%, reduced compressor wear and friction, extended equipment life, lower maintenance costs, improved heat transfer efficiency, environmentally friendly (reduces carbon footprint), and one-time permanent treatment (no reapplication needed).

tests.question: Does treatment void equipment warranty?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained treatment does not void OEM warranty under Magnuson-Moss Act, cited federal law protection for consumers, mentioned some manufacturers explicitly approve the treatment
tests.expected_answer: No. Under the Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act (federal law), manufacturers cannot void a warranty unless they can prove the aftermarket product caused the damage. PermaFrost NMR has never voided a warranty in 15+ years of use. Some OEMs have explicitly approved the treatment.

tests.question: How long does PermaFrost NMR last in the system?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained treatment is permanent, bonds at molecular level, lasts life of compressor, no reapplication needed, only reapply if compressor replaced or major refrigerant loss
tests.expected_answer: PermaFrost NMR is a permanent treatment. The nano-layer bonds permanently to metal surfaces and lasts the life of the compressor. No reapplication is needed unless the compressor is replaced or there is a major refrigerant loss that requires flushing the system.

tests.question: Is there ASHRAE research supporting this technology?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI cited ASHRAE RP-751 and RP-601 research projects confirming oil contamination degrades heat exchanger efficiency by 5-30%, explained how this research validates the mechanism by which PermaFrost NMR improves efficiency
tests.expected_answer: Yes. ASHRAE Research Projects RP-751 and RP-601 documented that oil contamination on heat exchanger surfaces degrades efficiency by 5-30%. This independent research validates the scientific basis for how PermaFrost NMR works - by cleaning oil fouling and preventing future contamination.

tests.question: What patents protect PermaFrost NMR?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI mentioned 4 patents protect the technology, explained patents cover formulation and application method, noted this prevents competitors from copying. Did not list specific patent numbers.
tests.expected_answer: PermaFrost NMR is protected by 4 US patents covering both the chemical formulation and application methodology. The specific patent numbers are available upon request. These patents prevent competitors from legally copying the precise formulation.
tests.notes: Answer is good but could include specific patent numbers if available in source documents

tests.question: What warranty does Powertron Global provide?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained Powertron warrants no equipment damage, $2M insurance per machine covering damage and revenue loss, 300,000+ deployments with zero damage claims, treatment does not void OEM warranties
tests.expected_answer: Powertron warrants that PermaFrost NMR will not damage equipment. They provide up to $2 million insurance per machine for damage and revenue loss. Over 300,000 deployments with zero damage claims filed.

tests.question: Can the treatment qualify for energy rebates?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly explained treatment qualifies for utility rebates using IPMVP Option B methodology, PE-certified results, measures actual kWh reduction, F2 FMV platform for real-time M&V, listed documentation provided to utilities
tests.expected_answer: Yes, PermaFrost NMR frequently qualifies for utility rebates. The treatment uses IPMVP methodology required by utilities, results are PE-certified, and the F2 FMV platform provides ongoing monitoring data that utilities require.

tests.question: Has PermaFrost NMR been tested by power companies or US government agencies?
tests.ai_response_summary: AI correctly cited 3 US government/military installations tested: Military Base A (Air Force), Defense Agency A (DOD), Military Base B. Mentioned rigorous procurement standards, 6-month studies, IPMVP-compliant protocols
tests.expected_answer: Yes. PermaFrost NMR has been tested at US government and military facilities including Air Force bases and DOD installations. These government studies provide highest level of credibility due to rigorous procurement standards and independent oversight.
